string.text: An ordinary battery from portable gear. Keeps the artefact belt running for about 0.25 game days, then it dies and has to be replaced. Barely noticeable in your pack at 0.1 kg.
A standard stalker accumulator. The artefact belt runs for roughly 0.5 game days. Weighs 0.5 kg.
A heavy army can: keeps the artefact belt alive for up to 1.5 game days, but weighs 2.5 kg - that reserve has to be carried on your back.
A laboratory power supply in a shielded case. Runs up to 1.5 game days and weighs only 1 kg - the scientists knew how to count energy.
A prototype from a closed laboratory. Gives the artefact belt up to 3 game days and weighs next to nothing - 0.5 kg. Only a few exist.
